material_findings: Training/serving representation contract was explicitly tightened via exact serving-format rendering, response-span-only loss and curriculum preservation.
Length-aware prompt-fact insertion was introduced because the full REALITAET block overflowed 1082 examples; earlier ~35% and later ~25% statements are lineage states, not one reconciled measurement.
The archived hybrid-model finding says only 8/32 layers use standard q/k/v/o attention while 24/32 use linear attention; seven standard LoRA targets therefore do not adapt all sequence-mixing paths.
The proposed v26.2 experiment is confounded by simultaneous changes to context length, adapter targets and prompt/data content.
No completed v26.2 training outcome is established by this batch; static validators and smoke-test source are not run results.

branch_implications.frank: Version training/serving serialization and prompt/state facts as runtime contracts.
branch_implications.harness: Require consumed held-out eval and intervention-isolated ablations for causal attribution.
branch_implications.clay: Inspect actual hybrid module topology before selecting adapter targets.

payload.level0_gate_effect: Adds an eight-unit bounded semantic disposition; global denominator remains unfrozen and gate remains NOT_PASS.
